title: Health questionnaire
intro: This is a confidential questionnaire about your health. It helps us look after you at work and make any changes you might need. Your answers are only seen by the people who need them to set up your role safely. Answer honestly: a Yes is not a reason to withdraw an offer, and we will talk to you about anything that needs support.

hazards.manual_handling: Manual handling (kegs, casks, stock, furniture, laundry, deliveries)
hazards.height: Working at height (ladders, cellar drop, changing optics/barrels, event set-up)
hazards.cellar: Cellar work (cold, CO2/gas, restricted space, heavy lifting)
hazards.hot: Hot surfaces / hot liquids / steam (kitchen, pass, dishwash)
hazards.slips: Slips, trips and falls (wet floors, spills, uneven grounds)
hazards.pool: Hot tub and pool plant / chemical dosing
hazards.food: Food handling - hygiene-critical (fitness to handle food)
hazards.shifts: Night, late or long shifts / irregular shift patterns
hazards.grounds: Grounds and maintenance machinery (mowers, powered/vibrating tools)
hazards.temperature: Extremes of temperature (cellar cold / kitchen heat / outdoors)

levels.risk: A personal risk assessment is needed
levels.exclusion: Do not handle food or start work until clear
